name: Postgres Tenant Boundary
description: A partially verifiable static policy for documenting tenant isolation boundaries.

sources.title: LMP tenant boundary methodology
sources.licenseNote: Summary only; no copied proprietary text.

principles: Make tenant boundaries explicit at the database boundary.
tradeoffs: Static signals are useful but cannot prove runtime isolation.
decisionRules: Require a documented boundary before treating a tenant-scoped table as reviewed.
antiPatterns: Do not treat an application filter as proof of database isolation.
